access_type: Open access for the last admitted cohorts; new enrolment ended after academic year 2024/2025
programme_name_history: Engineering and Management for Health (EMH); Italian official title: Ingegneria e gestione delle tecnologie per la salute. The programme remains online for continuing cohorts, but the department states that enrolment was available only through academic year 2024/2025.
admission_type: No active 2026/2027 admission. Historically open access, subject to curricular and personal-preparation assessment.
academic_requirements: Historical requirements for the last admitted cohorts: a three-year bachelor's degree or a foreign qualification recognized as suitable, with adequate preparation in engineering fundamentals (mathematics, physics and chemistry), Industrial Engineering class L-9 subjects, biomedical engineering, medicine and biology. The detailed minimum was 39 CFU in basic activities, 15 CFU in Management Engineering fields, 6 CFU in Biomedical Engineering, and 6 CFU in medical/biological fields. These requirements are retained for historical context only because new enrolment ended after 2024/2025.

curricular_requirements_cfu.mathematics_computer_science_statistics: At least 21 CFU in MAT/02, MAT/03, MAT/05, MAT/06, MAT/07, MAT/08, MAT/09, SECS-S/01, SECS-S/02, INF/01 or ING-INF/05
curricular_requirements_cfu.physics_chemistry: At least 18 CFU in CHIM/03, CHIM/07, FIS/01 or FIS/03
curricular_requirements_cfu.management_engineering: At least 15 CFU in ING-IND/16, ING-IND/17, ING-IND/35 or ING-INF/04
curricular_requirements_cfu.biomedical_engineering: At least 6 CFU in ING-IND/34 or ING-INF/06
curricular_requirements_cfu.medical_biological: At least 6 CFU in BIO/09, BIO/11, BIO/16, MED/04 or MED/05

entry_exam_or_test: No active 2026/2027 entry examination or test. Historically, admission involved assessment of curricular requirements and personal preparation by a programme committee.
interview_required: No active 2026/2027 admission interview. Historical regulations refer to verification of personal preparation, but the currently indexed English admission page does not specify whether this always took the form of an interview [uncertain].
interview_language: Not applicable for 2026/2027; historical interview language not stated [uncertain].
selection_scoring: No active selection or scoring rubric for 2026/2027. No historical numeric ranking threshold was identified on the official programme admission page.
degree_completion_deadline: Not applicable because the programme has no new 2026/2027 intake. The programme page still contains an obsolete conditional pre-registration deadline of 31 October 2019, which must not be used for current admissions.
application_channel: No application channel is available for a new 2026/2027 enrolment. The programme is absent from the official 2026/2027 DreamApply catalogue and from the official 2026/2027 international pre-evaluation list. The remaining programme site serves continuing cohorts.
language_requirements: Historical requirement: English at CEFR B2 or equivalent. Not applicable to a new 2026/2027 application because the intake is closed.
accepted_english_certificates: The programme-specific historical page requires a B2 certificate or equivalent but does not publish a certificate-by-certificate list. Any former central equivalency list should not be treated as a current EMH admission rule [uncertain].
language_waiver_conditions: No programme-specific waiver conditions were identified on the official EMH admission page [uncertain].
application_deadline_non_eu: Not applicable — EMH is not included in the official 2026/2027 international pre-evaluation programme list.
application_call_round: None for 2026/2027. Enrolment was available only through academic year 2024/2025.
max_programme_choices: Not applicable to EMH because it is unavailable in the 2026/2027 application catalogue.
required_documents: No current 2026/2027 application document list exists for EMH. Historical applicants would have needed degree and curriculum evidence plus proof of B2 English, but a complete programme-specific historical checklist was not identified [uncertain].
references_required: Not applicable for 2026/2027; no programme-specific historical requirement identified [uncertain].
course_descriptions_required: Not applicable for 2026/2027. Course documentation would historically have been needed to verify the detailed CFU/SSD prerequisites, but the exact submission format is not stated on the EMH page [uncertain].
tuition_or_fees_link: https://en.unibg.it/study/enrollment/costs/taxes-and-benefits — general University of Bergamo fee information for students, including continuing cohorts; there is no new EMH intake fee for 2026/2027.
tuition_income_linked: University of Bergamo tuition is generally income-linked, but no current fee assessment applies to a new EMH entrant because the programme is closed to new enrolment.
official_call_url: No active official call URL for 2026/2027. Official catalogue: https://apply.unibg.it/courses/browse

uncertainty_notes: The decisive current official evidence is that new enrolment was offered only through academic year 2024/2025. EMH is absent from both the official 2026/2027 international pre-evaluation list and the 2026/2027 DreamApply browse catalogue, although its programme website remains online for continuing students. The admission page contains detailed historical requirements and an obsolete 31 October 2019 date; these must not be interpreted as current. Earlier DreamApply course IDs 13 and 16 now resolve to the general browse page and do not establish an active intake.
source_access_status: Official UNIBG sources only. The programme homepage, study-plan page, department programme list, 2026/2027 DreamApply catalogue, and central international pre-evaluation page were directly indexed or accessible. The admission-requirements URL returned an HTTP 405 on direct retrieval, but its full official UNIBG indexed text was available in search results.
